title: Own damage cover
text: Own damage cover pays for repairs to your car after an accident, collision, fire, theft, flood or cyclone. Repairs at network garages are cashless.

title: Third-party liability
text: Third-party liability covers injury to other people and damage to their property. Third-party cover is mandatory under the Motor Vehicles Act.

title: Claim intimation
text: You must inform us of any accident within 48 hours by calling the claims desk or using the app. Late intimation may lead to the claim being rejected.

title: Documents required
text: To register a claim you need the policy number, a copy of your driving licence, the vehicle registration certificate and photographs of the damage.

title: Theft claims
text: For theft you must file an FIR with the police within 24 hours. A theft claim is settled after the police issue a non-traceable report, usually within 90 days.

title: Flood and engine damage
text: Flood damage to the body is covered under own damage. Engine damage caused by water ingress or hydrostatic lock is covered only with the Engine Protect add-on.

title: Exclusions
text: We do not pay claims when the driver had no valid licence, was driving under the influence of alcohol, or the car was used for racing.

title: Zero depreciation add-on
text: With the zero depreciation add-on we pay the full cost of replaced plastic, rubber and metal parts without deducting depreciation, for up to two claims a year.

title: No claim bonus
text: The no claim bonus is a discount on own damage premium for every claim-free year, starting at 20 percent and rising to 50 percent after five years.

title: Personal accident cover
text: Compulsory personal accident cover for the owner-driver pays 15 lakh rupees for death or permanent total disability in an accident.

title: Grievances
text: If you are unhappy with a claim decision, write to the grievance cell. If it is not resolved within 30 days you can approach the Insurance Ombudsman.

title: Cashless garages
text: Cashless repairs are available at more than 4,000 network garages. At other garages you pay first and we reimburse approved costs.
